messages.subject: Project Ironvale - first DD enquiries
messages.plaintextBody:
David,

Thank you for opening the data room. Our first-round legal due diligence enquiries are below (full list in the DD workbook):
1. The Hollencroft supply contract - please confirm whether it contains a change-of-control clause.
2. THERMACORE trade marks - status of the EU application.
3. The FY2023 R&D tax credit - any open HMRC correspondence.
4. Northbank debenture - terms of release on a sale.

Grateful for replies in the data room.

Elena

Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Ironvale - first DD enquiries
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

Replies uploaded. In short: (1) yes, Hollencroft has a change-of-control right - consent letter requested; (2) EU mark is under opposition, UK is registered; (3) HMRC enquiry into the R&D claim is open but we consider it well-founded; (4) Northbank will release on repayment at completion. Shout with any follow-ups.

David Lin
